description: This file contains classes and functions related to partitioning and fusing graph nodes in PyTorch FX, including Partition management, dependency analysis, and partitioning strategies for model optimization.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Represents a collection of nodes with an optional identifier and node orderings, used for managing graph partitions.

classes.name: _DependencyViewer
classes.description: Analyzes downstream dependencies between nodes in a graph module.

classes.name: CapabilityBasedPartitioner
classes.description: Performs partitioning of a graph module based on operator support and dependencies, with methods for proposing, merging, and fusing partitions.

methods.name: Partition.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Partition with optional id, nodes, and node orders.

methods.name: Partition.__repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the partition nodes.

methods.name: Partition.add_node
methods.description: Adds a node to the partition with an optional node order.

methods.name: Partition.remove_node
methods.description: Removes a node from the partition.

methods.name: Partition.size
methods.description: Returns the number of nodes in the partition.

methods.name: _DependencyViewer.__init__
methods.description: Builds a downstream dependency map for nodes in a graph module.

methods.name: _DependencyViewer.downstreams_of
methods.description: Returns downstream nodes of a given node.

methods.name: CapabilityBasedPartitioner.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the partitioner with a graph module, operator support, and configuration options.

methods.name: CapabilityBasedPartitioner._is_node_supported
methods.description: Checks if a node is supported based on operator support.

methods.name: CapabilityBasedPartitioner.propose_partitions
methods.description: Proposes graph partitions based on operator support and dependencies.

methods.name: CapabilityBasedPartitioner.fuse_partitions
methods.description: Fuses given partitions into a single graph module.

methods.name: CapabilityBasedPartitioner.remove_bookend_non_compute_ops
methods.description: Removes non-compute boundary nodes from partitions.

methods.name: CapabilityBasedPartitioner.partition_and_fuse
methods.description: Performs partitioning and then fuses the partitions into a new graph module.
